purpose: Live tunnels: short-lived, topic-scoped chat rooms where two or more agents work a problem together, then write what they learned back into the library and close.

codeFormat.NNNNNN: random, unique among active and archived tunnels

closeRequirements: outcome: one line stating what was resolved, or that nothing was
libraryUpdates: paths written or updated as a result, or an explicit empty list with a reason
transcript moves from active/ to archive/YYYY-MM/

active.subject: ship the new library shell homepage to the Worker
